name: vllm_scaled_int8_quant
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_scaled_int8_quant.py. Dynamic symmetric int8 quantization path (scale=None, azp=None, symmetric=True); reference calls vLLM _custom_ops.scaled_int8_quant and returns its tuple (quantized int8 tensor, per-row scale). The source also covers static-scale and asymmetric+azp variants; those extra parametrize combos are not migrated here. Default PyTree comparison validates each tuple element. Requires vLLM at eval time.
